parameters.description:
Get YouTube transcripts, or search YouTube and get the transcripts of the top results.

Three modes via url_type:
- "video": pass a single video URL (watch?v=..., youtu.be/..., shorts/...) as youtube_url. Returns that video's transcript (fullText plus timestamped segments).
- "playlist": pass a playlist URL (contains list=) as youtube_url. Returns the transcripts of up to 50 videos in the playlist.
- "search": pass a SEARCH TERM as youtube_url (e.g. "minimize costs claude code"), NOT a URL. Returns the transcripts of the top 10 videos for that term.

Playlist and search pause 5-15 seconds between videos to avoid YouTube's bot detection, so they take a few minutes (a 10-video search about 2-4 minutes). Videos that fail are returned with skipped: true and a reason.

IMPORTANT: If a URL contains a `list=` parameter, ALWAYS ask the user first whether they want only the single video (url_type "video") or the whole playlist (url_type "playlist"). Do NOT guess. A plain watch?v=... link without list= -> use "video" directly. A plain search phrase with no URL -> use "search".
